race.comment: WHY NOW (6) finished seventh two starts ago then recorded a comfortable victory last start, scoring by 40 metres over 2190m at Mt Gambier. Meets a comparable field so he can continue the winning form. CONNIES PRESIDENT NZ (5) went back last start and failed to threaten when 8 metres from the winner in fourth at Maryborough over 1690m. That effort followed a win at this track two runs ago. Big chance if he is at his best. ATABOY CHARLIE (3) is worth another chance after a last-start tenth over 2120m at St Arnaud two weeks ago. ROBERT JOHN (2) should be at his peak at the fourth run back from a spell, the latest outing a eighth at Ballarat four days ago.
